atoms.b: The rabbit and the hedgehog sat around their small fire at night. They were keeping themselves warm while telling each other stories. Then, they ran out of stories. What should they do?

atoms.b: The rabbit and hedgehog sat around the fire.
They were telling stories and keeping themselves warm.
The pair ran out of stories.
In the distance, they heard a sound coming closer. The rabbit and the hedgehog were afraid. Out of the bushes came a fox! He was holding a strange object in his paw.

atoms.b: The rabbit and hedgehog heard an approaching sound.
The rabbit and hedgehog were afraid.
A fox appeared out of the bushes holding a strange object in his paw.

It was a guitar! The fox was cold and asked the rabbit and hedgehog whether he could sit with them by the fire. “Will you eat us?” asked the hedgehog. The fox replied, “No, I will not eat you, but I can share my music with you!”

atoms.b: The fox asked whether he could join the pair by the fire.
The hedgehog was worried about being eaten.
It turned out that the fox only wants to play music.

“What is music?” the pair asked the fox. “Music is a melody with a story,” said the fox. “I heard you telling stories earlier, shall we sing together with my guitar and your stories?” They played all night.

The fox explained what music was and offered to play with them.
They played music the whole night.
